CREATE TABLE `topicLibrary` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `originalTopicId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `titleEn` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `teacherId` int NOT NULL,
  `teacherName` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `publishedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `status` enum('published','used','withdrawn') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `suitableFor` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `topicSource` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `researchProjectName` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `guidanceLogs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `teacherId` int NOT NULL,
  `guidanceDate` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `topic` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('draft','submitted','confirmed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `academicYear` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `guidanceAttachments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `logId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `studentId` int NOT NULL,
  `fileName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `fileUrl` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `fileKey` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `mimeType` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fileSize` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `guidanceComments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `logId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `userRole` enum('student','teacher') NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
